Parking Signs

AeroParks asked Vinyl Wrap Toronto to design and mount their new Parking Signs. Have you driven past signs or posters and wondered why people even bother these days? Who still pays attention to advertising on billboards or signs? For a business, physical marketing is still a major influencer in bringing in new clients.
One sign that many people still look for these days is parking signs. Whether downtown or around a busy area like the airport. Most drivers are always looking for a parking spot, the closer and easier access to the destination the better. With many places around the busy areas charging for parking now. One of the main requirements of a parking sign is that the price is clear. Our designers listened to the customer requirements as well as worked with the location of the Parking Signs.
Aeroparks came to us to create a sign for their new parking facility. The local planning office has strict requirements that we and the owners had to adhere to. Vinyl Wrap Toronto has been working with Aeroparks for a few years, wrapping their vans. Click here to view the van decal wraps.

The sign was cut and printed using the colors of the Aeroparks logo. Once ready, our installation team then installed parts of the sign at the parking location. Due to the size of the sign 8×8 feet, we had to hire a professional team to hang the main signs. This Aeroparks Parking Sign was designed to survive the cold of the winter and the heat of summer.
Visit us in-store for prices on signs and wrapping information at 24 Ronson Drive, Unit #1, Etobicoke, M9W 1B4. Vinyl Wrap Toronto has done window graphics as well as perforated vinyl on vehicles and windows.
